mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand strength, which is associated with rising corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below its 6-month moving average), supply chain disruptions and reduced manufacturing output lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high consumer price index (CPIAUCSL above 270.0) reflects elevated inflation, which typically triggers aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS < 0) signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate revenue declines and trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth above 2.0%) and rising housing starts (HOUST above 3-month moving average) indicates robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% and HOUST is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 2017 base level (INDPRO < 100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.
